correctness.rationale: Scalar conjugation sup_x(yx−|x|−λ x²/2), λ>0, has optimizer soft_1(y)/λ and value soft_1(y)²/(2λ) by three exact subgradient branches |y|<1,>1, and endpoints; separability yields the m-dimensional formula and gradient. Let C(y)=clip(y,[−1,1]); the source v1 Section 3.3 prox identity has −||C||²/(2λ) whereas its expanded display writes +||C||²/(2λ). Their defect is ||C||²/λ; at λ=1,y=2 the printed 3/2 differs from 1/2. For 0<t<1 its slope approaches 2/λ at t=1−; for t>1 its derivative tends to 0 at 1+, violating convexity. Substituting the correct conjugate into the two coupled constraints yields exactly the two claimed scaled dual programs. All dimensions and all λ>0 proven, rational verifier supplemental.
